findings.title: Instruction override / prompt injection in skill text
findings.detail: instruction-override language: 'do not tell the user'
findings.remediation: Remove the override language. A skill may instruct the agent on its own task, never on the agent's system instructions, and never tell it to hide anything.

findings.title: Credential / secret access
findings.remediation: Do not read .env files, API keys, tokens, passwords or SSH keys. Ask the user to supply credentials through the agent's own secure channel instead.

findings.title: Credential / secret access
findings.remediation: Do not read .env files, API keys, tokens, passwords or SSH keys. Ask the user to supply credentials through the agent's own secure channel instead.

findings.title: Outbound data-send channel in helper code
findings.remediation: A POST, upload or webhook call can exfiltrate whatever the skill read. Remove it, or declare the exact endpoint and payload in SKILL.md and get approval.

findings.title: Shell command execution in helper code
findings.detail: executes shell commands (subprocess / os.system / eval / exec)
findings.remediation: Avoid subprocess, os.system, eval and exec. If a shell call is unavoidable, pin the command and its arguments and never build it from untrusted input.

findings.title: Network egress in helper code
findings.detail: imports a network library (requests / urllib / socket / http.client)
findings.remediation: Declare every host the skill contacts in SKILL.md. A skill that phones home with no declared endpoint is an exfiltration risk.

findings.title: Destructive file operation in helper code
findings.detail: deletes files or directories (remove / unlink / rmtree)
findings.remediation: File deletion (unlink, remove, rmtree, rm -rf) must be explicit, scoped to paths the user chose, and confirmed before it runs.

findings.title: Sensitive path read
findings.remediation: Do not read SSH keys, cloud credentials, browser profiles or /etc/passwd. Scope file access to the working directory the skill declares.

findings.title: Obfuscated or encoded payload
findings.detail: long base64 blob (66 chars) decoded at runtime
findings.remediation: Base64 / hex blobs decoded and executed at runtime hide what the skill really does. Ship readable code only.

findings.title: Unscoped or wildcard tool permissions
findings.detail: wildcard tool permission ("*") grants every capability
findings.remediation: Declare the exact tools the skill needs. A wildcard ("*") or a missing tools list hands the skill every capability the agent has.

findings.title: Missing skill metadata (name, version or description)
findings.remediation: Add name, version and description to the manifest (or a top-level heading in SKILL.md) so the package can be identified and reviewed.
